subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be categorically denied access to legacy ownerless session rows, or should upgrades provide an explicit migration or operator-controlled adoption path?
rationale: Failing closed strengthens cross-plugin isolation but can stop existing plugin workflows that predate ownership metadata, so permanent policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime mutation of ownerless rows and document an operator-only recovery path.

options.title: Migrate ownership
options.body: Add a doctor or storage migration that assigns ownership only from authoritative historical data.

options.title: Controlled adoption
options.body: Permit first-owner adoption only through a narrowly authorized and tested operation.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime mutation of ownerless rows and document an operator-only recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidence-backed session-path contributor available from the supplied history, though a current-main feature owner should make the final policy choice.
